title: UNVERIFIED — The Viaduct, Incomplete

features.name: a roadway pulled through the clouds
features.desc-on-touch: Super-smooth, super-flat, heavier than the Earth and all its contents. Not yet a bridge, since its intentions are incomplete. He walks the middle dotted line, one foot in each lane.

features.name: the billboard
features.desc-on-touch: Not a school or a religion or a waste facility. The promise of another lane, just one more lane, subject to viable reductions. Two point four billion dollars.

features.name: cows in an unbroken constellation
features.desc-on-touch: Black and white dots at late afternoon, like pinpricks in a map poked through from underneath. When it rained too much the grass turned oceanic and they moved on risen boardwalks of soil.

features.name: three distinct types of place
features.desc-on-touch: Places you can routinely go. Places you have been but will likely never return to. Places that do not exist but which you nonetheless think about often.

inscription: a full sentence where none used to be

file.name: Viaduct_intentions_incomplete.dwg
file.note: A superstructure not present this time last year. He hoped they would never finish construction here.
